verdict.rationale: Intel's own docs confirm a dedicated NPU as part of a three-engine AI architecture and point to shipping SDK/runtime tooling (oneAPI, oneDNN, PyTorch optimizations, VTune NPU/GPU profiling), so an official developer-facing runtime exists today. However, none of the evidence in this pack states a specific NPU TOPS figure or the precision (e.g., INT8) it's measured at, which the story explicitly requires. Missing for 10: a published TOPS number for the 258V's NPU, explicit precision statement, and a named SDK (e.g., OpenVINO) directly tied to NPU inference.
